feature.series: Integer in Focus, International Women in Engineering Day
feature.quote: I decided that I wanted to be a part of building a solution instead of prescribing it.
feature.photoAlt: Avery as a little girl in an oversized white lab coat, grinning beside an X-ray on a lightbox.

rows.value: Outdoors preferred. Performance improves noticeably after a bike ride.
Higher than I would like to admit. See OUTSIDE and GND for mitigation.
Buys project kits faster than she builds them.
Equally into cute things and The Matrix. Gets along with cats, plants, and anyone who will talk about either.

pins.label: VCC
pins.title: Lattes
pins.note: Runs on lattes. That's the whole spec.
pins.alt: A latte with cinnamon on top, next to a laptop showing this site's home page.
pins.caption: my usual

pins.label: OUTSIDE
pins.title: Outside
pins.note: Anywhere that isn't a desk. This is me and my little sister Lea out on the kayaks. I've also canoed with Bengals in the Wild, a hiking club at LSU.
pins.alt: Avery and her little sister Lea smiling from kayaks on dark water at golden hour.
pins.caption: Outside

pins.label: SNOW
pins.title: Snow
pins.note: Me vs. the snowboard. Started young and still wiping out.
pins.alt: Avery as a kid, flat on her back in the snow in pink snow pants, her snowboard beside her.
pins.caption: Snow

pins.label: FIELD
pins.title: Field
pins.note: Goalie for varsity soccer and shortstop for varsity softball in high school. At LSU I played intramural flag football and softball until most of my team graduated. We won this one.
pins.alt: Avery's intramural team in matching champions shirts on a lit softball field at night.
pins.caption: Field

pins.label: THRIFT
pins.title: Old things
pins.note: I go for the old stuff, not the clothes. My favorite find is this 1950s Argus camera, flash and bulb still attached, from the flea markets I used to go to with my grandparents.
pins.alt: A 1950s Argus Super Seventy-Five box camera with its round flash reflector and flashbulb attached, on a wooden shelf.
pins.caption: Old things

pins.label: TYGA
pins.title: Tyga
pins.note: My Bengal. Head of quality control.
pins.alt: Tyga, a spotted cat with green eyes, sitting upright and looking straight at the camera.
pins.caption: Tyga

pins.label: SIDEQ
pins.title: Side quests
pins.note: [LED visualizers](/work/led-audio-spectrum/) for my sisters, [a pool alarm](/work/acoustic-pool-alarm/) I want to build, and a pile of soldering kits I swear I'll get to.
pins.alt: A 16 by 16 LED matrix lit up with an audio spectrum, columns of light rising from red at the bottom to white peaks.
pins.caption: Side quests

pins.label: FILM
pins.title: Graduation, with Grandma Joyce
pins.note: My Polaroid comes everywhere with me. I like having something tangible I can hold from the days that matter, like this one.
pins.alt: An instant print of Avery in her 2026 cap and gown holding her LSU diploma and sunflowers, cheek to cheek with her Grandma Joyce.

pins.label: FAIRE
pins.title: Ren Faire Day
pins.note: Big fan. I go all in: costume, flower crown, the whole shebang. Apparently I started early (that's me as a pirate with my big brother Rickey).
pins.alt: Avery in a blue Renaissance dress and flower crown, lying in the woods at a Renaissance faire with friends and her dad.
pins.caption: Ren Faire Day

extra.alt: Avery as a little girl in a pirate costume, frowning, next to her big brother Rickey holding a toy sword.
extra.caption: Started early.

pins.label: GND
pins.title: Ground
pins.note: The levee is where I go to reset. Sometimes there's a turtle sunbathing on the slope.
pins.alt: A turtle in tall green grass.
pins.caption: Ground

pins.label: READ
pins.title: The Last Lecture
pins.note: I love to read. My big brother Rickey handed me this one a few years ago and said it changed his whole perspective. He wants it back, so I'm reading it slowly on purpose.
pins.alt: Avery's hand holding open The Last Lecture by Randy Pausch to the chapter The Dutch Uncle, outside in the sun.
pins.caption: still owe Rickey this book back

pins.label: NC
pins.title: No connect
pins.note: Reserved for whatever I get into next.
pins.caption: No connect
